map.输入供应商五大维度信息（资质/财务/产能/质量/供货），系统自动计算准入评分并分: Enter the supplier's five-dimension information (qualification/finance/capacity/quality/delivery), and the system automatically calculates the admission score and grades them as strategic/preferred/qualified/eliminated suppliers.
map.📖 查看「供应商准入评估与分级 使用指南」: 📖 View "Supplier Admission Evaluation and Grading Guide"
map.五维度等权重（各20%），各项满分100分: Five dimensions with equal weight (each 20%), each item full score 100
map.分级标准：≥85分战略供应商，70-84优选，60-69合格，<60淘汰: Grading standard: ≥85 strategic supplier, 70-84 preferred, 60-69 qualified, <60 eliminated
map.资产负债率>70%或无ISO认证自动降一级: Debt-to-asset ratio >70% or no ISO certification automatically downgrades one level
map.评估结果作为准入参考，需结合实地考察: The evaluation result serves as an admission reference and should be combined with on-site inspection
map.📚 深度解析：供应商准入评估与分级: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Supplier Admission Evaluation and Grading
map.新供应商引入前，录入资质、财务、产能、质量、供货五大维度信息，自动算出准入总分并: Before introducing a new supplier, enter the five dimensions of qualification, finance, capacity, quality, and delivery, and automatically calculate the total admission score and determine strategic/preferred/qualified/eliminated.
map.年度供应商复评时，更新各项指标，重新分级，作为份额分配与汰换决策依据。: During the annual supplier re-evaluation, update the indicators, re-grade, and use as the basis for share allocation and replacement decisions.
map.对临界分值的供应商做敏感性分析：调整负债率或 ISO 认证状态，观察是否触发扣分: Perform sensitivity analysis on suppliers at critical scores: adjust the debt ratio or ISO certification status to observe whether deduction items are triggered, causing downgrade.
map.输入：注册资本 2000 万、经营 12 年、资质 4 级、ISO 4 级、营收: Input: registered capital 20,000,000 CNY, operating 12 years, qualification grade 4, ISO grade 4, revenue 80,000,000 CNY,
map.40%、信用 4 级、产能满足率 160%、设备 4 级、合格率 99%、客诉率: 40%, credit grade 4, capacity fulfillment 160%, equipment grade 4, pass rate 99%, complaint rate 1%, on-time rate 97%, cooperation 6 years. Five-dimension scores: enterprise qualification 92, finance 87, capacity 88, quality 89.4, delivery 98.2; total = round((92+87+88+89.4+98.2)/5) = 91 → strategic supplier (≥85). No deductions (debt ratio ≤70, ISO ≠1). If changed to debt ratio 75% and no ISO certification, both items deduct 10 points, total drops to 71 → preferred supplier.
map.分级阈值怎么定？: How are the grading thresholds set?
map.总分 ≥85 为战略供应商（优先签长期协议）、≥70 优选、≥60 合格（限制份: Total score ≥85 for strategic supplier (priority long-term agreement), ≥70 preferred, ≥60 qualified (limit share and track improvement), <60 unqualified (eliminated, not included in the list). Additional penalty items: debt-to-asset ratio >70% deducts 10 points, no ISO certification (iso=1) deducts 10 points; after deduction it may cross levels.
map.资质=注册资本/产量系数+经营年限+资质等级+ISO 等级；财务=营收规模+负债: Qualification = registered capital/output coefficient + operating years + qualification grade + ISO grade; finance = revenue scale + debt-ratio grading (≤30→30 points, decreasing stepwise to >85→0) + credit rating; capacity = capacity fulfillment segmentation (≥150%→40 cap) + equipment grade; quality = pass-rate mapping + complaint deduction; delivery = on-time rate + cooperation years. Each item capped at 100, then take the five-dimension mean and round.
map.供应商准入评估与分级管理工具，从企业资质、财务状况、生产能力、质量体系、供货记录: Supplier admission evaluation and grading management tool that quantitatively scores suppliers across five dimensions — enterprise qualification, financial status, production capacity, quality system, and delivery record — automatically grading them into four categories: strategic/preferred/qualified/eliminated, with support for automatic penalty deductions.
